fieldGuide: See models/MODEL_METADATA.md. Each model has separate integrity, localAvailability, distribution, license and use fields. The app loader (js/embedding/model-policy.js) refuses anything not explicitly allowed.

face.integrityEvidence: Size and SHA-256 match the Git LFS pointer of opencv/opencv_zoo models/face_recognition_sface/face_recognition_sface_2021dec.onnx at commit ba91a3b91d00d76e86540d4013f944bd6b514e39; the file was downloaded from that pinned commit and re-checked on 2026-11-13. The hash identifies this exact file only; it does not establish training-data provenance.
face.localAvailabilityNote: .gitignore excludes models/**/*.onnx. The file exists only where it was placed by hand (the project owner's Codespace). A fresh clone or a static deployment has no file; the loader then reports MODEL FILE NOT FOUND.
face.distributionNote: Must not be published (repository, release, static hosting, public forwarded port) while commercial clearance is UNVERIFIED.

license.statusNote: UNVERIFIED for commercial clearance. Not approved for commercial use or production.
license.weights: Apache-2.0 as stated by OpenCV Zoo: 'All files in this directory are licensed under Apache 2.0 License' (models/face_recognition_sface/README.md and LICENSE). The LICENSE copyright line is an unfilled template placeholder.
license.trainingData: UNRESOLVED. The training dataset of this file is not stated by OpenCV Zoo. The SFace paper (arXiv 2205.12010) reports models trained on MS1MV2 (derived from MS-Celeb-1M) and VGGFace2; which dataset trained this MobileFaceNet file is unknown, and those datasets' terms may restrict commercial use.
license.attribution: SFace: Yaoyao Zhong et al. (arXiv 2205.12010); ONNX conversion by Chengrui Wang (OpenCV Zoo).

input.name: data
input.normalizationInGraph: (x - 127.5) * 0.0078125, i.e. (x - 127.5) / 128 (first two graph nodes: Sub, Mul)

reid.integrityEvidence: Exported on 2026-11-15 by tools/convert-osnet-to-onnx.py (torch 2.5.1, opset 13) from the Torchreid model-zoo checkpoint osnet_x0_25_msmt17_combineall_256x128_amsgrad_ep150_stp60_lr0.0015_b64_fb10_softmax_labelsmooth_flip_jitter.pth (9,336,983 bytes, SHA-256 cf55163d78fc44c62c82f85ab62d39f10438679b5abe8c698ae08cfa84aa6e18), downloaded by the owner from the Google Drive link in Torchreid docs/MODEL_ZOO.md @ f8cd150. Loaded with torch.load(weights_only=True); 565 tensors kept, classifier dropped. ONNX vs PyTorch max |diff| 1.1e-4 on 5 random inputs. The hash identifies this exported file only.
reid.localAvailabilityNote: .gitignore excludes models/**/*.onnx. The file exists only on the owner's laptop (C:\follow-app\models\person-reid).
reid.distributionNote: Must not be published while commercial clearance is UNVERIFIED.
